newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 25.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Health Minister Jacques Barrot calls for use of generic drugs instead of more expensive brandname products whenever possible, says pharmacists may have right to fill prescriptions with generic equivalents of prescribed products.
-- Industry Minister wants a plan to reshuffle management at EDF electricity utility, aimed at concentrating decision-making in hands of chairman Edmond Alphandery, to be submitted to its board.
-- CGT union calls for strike on Oct 17 at SNCF rail operator.
-- Ailing airline Air Liberte negotiates with shareholders Banque Rivaud, Indosuez and ILFC, could file for bankruptcy if fails to reach agreement on Thursday.
-- Insurer Axa posts first-half net attributable profit up 52 percent at 1.98 billion francs.
-- New automated European market for high-technology firms EASDAQ to open in Brussels in October.
-- State to grant a 3.9-billion franc emergency package to ailing bank Credit Lyonnais.
